def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # normalize sex labels
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({'nan': None})
    # parse body_mass_g written as text (handles commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # flipper_length_mm may be text
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # enforce valid ranges: out-of-range values become NaN
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    totals = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in totals.items()}
